tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer (all genders)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position at adesso SE. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms for major global brands like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: REST and OCC APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and built RESTful APIs for Headless Commerce integrations and Progressive Web Application frontends.

bullets.label: Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Cloud & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows.

cover_en.gap: While my core expertise lies in SAP Commerce Cloud backend development, I am keen to further expand my skills in any specialized platform extensions required by your team.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your team.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to adesso SE because of your strong reputation in digital business and enterprise e-commerce solutions. I am eager to contribute my hands-on experience in Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs to your dynamic project teams.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience and a passion for robust e-commerce architectures to adesso SE.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I saw the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer opening at adesso SE. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, valid German work authorization, and availability starting December 16, 2026, I would love to connect.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position at adesso SE. With over 5 years of experience developing enterprise e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, and SAP Commerce Cloud.

I possess a valid German work permit and am available to start on December 16, 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my qualifications with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
